definition.shortText: CUNI BC Set read only route metadata
source: lt_headers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF objh,
lt_members TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF objs,
lt_methods TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF objm,
lv_table TYPE tddat-tabname, lv_group TYPE tddat-cclass,
lv_code TYPE string, lv_system TYPE string,
lv_client TYPE string, lv_user TYPE string,
lv_source TYPE string, lv_target TYPE string,
lv_buffer TYPE xstring, lv_first TYPE xstring,
lv_hash TYPE string, lv_count TYPE i, lv_pass TYPE i,
lt_t006 TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF t006,
lt_t006a TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF t006a,
lt_t006b TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF t006b,
lt_t006c TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF t006c,
lt_t006d TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF t006d.
" 固定 CUNI/T 元数据读取；不调用任何动态方法或配置命令。
" 表名固定，逐表显示权限；沿用既有 READ 的授权模式。
SELECT SINGLE cclass INTO lv_group FROM tddat
IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lv_group IS INITIAL.
" 顺序双读不是锁定快照；任何变化都不返回可用元数据。
et_t006b = lt_t006b et_t006c = lt_t006c et_t006d = lt_t006d
IF lv_system <> sy-sysid OR lv_client <> sy-mandt
OR lv_user <> sy-uname OR lv_source <> iv_source_version
SELECT SINGLE * INTO ls_header FROM objh
" 排除与执行路线无关的维护用户名和日期，避免外传个人信息。
SELECT * FROM objs INTO TABLE lt_members UP TO 21 ROWS
SELECT * FROM objm INTO TABLE lt_methods UP TO 11 ROWS
SORT lt_members BY objectname objecttype tabname.
SORT lt_methods BY objectname objecttype method.
system = sy-sysid client = sy-mandt user = sy-uname
headers = lt_headers members = lt_members methods = lt_methods
" 双读之后再次核对完整源和目标版本，输出仍未填充。
et_t006b = lt_t006b et_t006c = lt_t006c et_t006d = lt_t006d
IF lv_system <> sy-sysid OR lv_client <> sy-mandt
OR lv_user <> sy-uname OR lv_source <> iv_source_version
IF strlen( lv_hash ) <> 64 OR lv_hash CN '0123456789abcdef'.
